Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT At Proxima Fusion, we are building the future of clean energy - and we need an experienced Warehouse Specialist who thrives in a fast-paced, hands-on environment. In this role, you will ensure the smooth and efficient flow of materials and equipment, supporting our engineering, R&D, and operational ambitions. You’ll be responsible for managing incoming and outgoing goods, maintaining accurate inventory records, coordinating shipments, and ensuring the safe handling and storage of materials. jobs.description: This role is located in Munich, Germany. TULIP is a hybrid work environment and we are in the office 3+ days/per week. About TULIP TULIP is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries. In January 2026, TULIP closed its $120M Series D , at a valuation of $1.3B. Leading global manufacturers run on TULIP, including VEKA, DMG Mori, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace and Mitsubishi Electric. We partner with NVIDIA, PwC, McKinsey, BCG and more than 160 technology partners worldwide. TULIP is part of the World Economic Forum's Global Innovator community, and our CEO, Dr. Natan Linder, co-chairs the Forum's Advanced Manufacturing Industry Governors Community. The opportunity in DACH for TULIP DACH is the heart of global manufacturing. Germany is Europe's largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value. TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP's headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. jobs.description: Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi . The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level. We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years. ABOUT THE ROLE Want to work at the frontier of AI and shape the most forward-looking event formats globally? Events are where TabPFN meets the world, and one of our strongest channels. jobs.description: Build something monumental for Healthcare! At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care. We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you! About the Role You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped. At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. jobs.title: GTM Associate
jobs.description: About Us Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity. Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance. We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth. Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures. Position Overview As a GTM Associate, you’ll sit at the centre of Condukt’s commercial engine, generating new pipeline across financial services and working hand in hand with our Account Executives to turn it into revenue. You’ll build opportunities from the ground up: reaching high-growth fintechs and financial institutions with well-researched outreach, qualifying inbound interest quickly, and running first discovery conversations. Your work doesn’t end at the first meeting. You’ll stay on the deal with our Account Executives, help build the customer relationship and, as you grow, lead smaller deals end to end alongside an AE. As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move with urgency, and are excited to help build both a market-leading product and a repeatable enterprise sales motion. You’ll work closely with our AI Deployment Strategists, Product, Engineering, and Leadership to shape how we sell, who we sell to, and how we win. If you’re at the start of your commercial career, energised by meeting new people, and keen to take on more responsibility fast, this role is for you.

jobs.description: The Opportunity This isn’t just a Sales Development role — it’s your chance to be the engine of Sitetracker’s pipeline growth during a high-impact period. As a French-speaking Senior Sales Development Representative, you’ll address the critical business need of generating a consistent, high-quality pipeline in our EMEA region. With increased investment and focus on international expansion, your efforts will directly influence revenue growth and market penetration in this dynamic, fast-paced environment. You’ll be stepping into a role with visibility, autonomy, and the support to shape how Sitetracker connects with prospective customers across London, Spain, and beyond. If you’re driven by the challenge of building scalable outbound strategies and crave the opportunity to make a measurable difference — this is it. What You’ll Do As a Senior SDR, you’ll play a pivotal front-line role in Sitetracker’s sales ecosystem. You’ll consistently generate high-quality leads and pipeline through thoughtful, targeted outreach, becoming a true partner to our account executives and a trusted voice to our prospects. This isn’t a “smile and dial” environment — it’s a career-defining opportunity to take ownership of your region and make strategic decisions about where and how we go to market. You’ll collaborate with marketing and sales leadership to refine messaging, run account-based plays, and experiment with new channels and approaches. Your success will be measured not just by volume, but by the business value of the opportunities you surface. In short, you won’t just be booking meetings — you’ll be driving real, scalable impact. jobs.description: Level Up Your Career! At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space. At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Life Assurance, Royal London Pension, a Free On-site Gym, Dog-friendly Office, LinkedIn Learning, 25 holiday days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra holiday for each year of service capped at 5. Join The Team! Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Senior User Acquisition Manager to steer User Acquisition across our mobile portfolio: live hits, much-loved classics, and exciting new games looking for their big break. We’ll shape the title around your experience, from Senior UA Manager to Lead UA Manager or even Head of UA, because it’s the impact that matters. This role is for you if you’re a hands-on UA leader who gets a real buzz from spotting where the next profitable pound of spend is hiding, and proving it. You’ll grow a team of UA Managers who proudly own their games, and bring an investor’s eye to the whole portfolio so every game and every campaign earns its place in the spotlight. This role is based on-site 5 days per week at our Leamington Spa studio, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation. What You’ll Do: Steer portfolio UA. Set the UA strategy across our games and channels, and put every pound where it works hardest. Grow a brilliant team. Lead and coach our UA Managers, give each of them clear ownership of their games, and help them do the best work of their careers. Unlock profitable scale. Find the games ready to grow faste

jobs.title: Field Operations Manager, EMEA
jobs.description: About Exa Exa is an applied AI research lab organizing the entire web for AI. Agents don't search like people do. They ask long, complex questions and need clean, accurate, real-time answers. So we train our own retrieval models and index hundreds of billions of webpages, giving agents grounded, cited answers instead of stale training data. And it's working. We've grown about 10x a year for three years, to more than $100M in annualized revenue and 2B+ requests a month from 200K+ teams. HubSpot, monday.com , Revolut, Firefox, Cognition, Cursor and OpenRouter all build on Exa. We raised a $250M Series C at a $2.2B valuation, led by a16z with Benchmark, Lightspeed, NVIDIA Ventures and Y Combinator. If you want to build core technology that's used every day, help build a generational company, and shape the revenue engine behind it, come join us. About the role Exa is hiring a Senior Field Operations Manager for EMEA, based in our new London office, to be the go-to partner for our EMEA sales leader, AEs, SDRs, partners and field engineers as the region grows from a handful of people into a full team. You’ll bring our GTM operations and programs to EMEA, partnering with our Head of Revenue Programs to decide what we keep, what we localize and what we build new for the region’s markets. You’ll be a swiss army knife across process, change management, light deal desk, insights and tools, with the relationships and judgment to tie it all together. If you’ve helped build ops in a new region and you love being close to the field, we’d love to talk! What you'll do You'll lean hard on AI across all of this. We expect AI to do much of the reporting, drafting and checking, so your time goes to the field and the conversations only a person can have. Be the person our EMEA sales leader and team go to first. jobs.description: About BlaBlaCar BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip. BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions. In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions. Their mission is to optimize our multimodal (Carpool, Bus, and Train supplies) booking and checkout experience for passengers, by integrating and unifying multiple heterogeneous inventory sources from external partners. You will be working with a full-stack team of 10 developers. jobs.title: Responsable de la communication interne - CDI Paris - Theodo
jobs.description: L’histoire de Theodo et son succès Depuis 2009, Theodo accompagne des entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux (plateforme TF1+, applications LCL Pro et France Identité Numérique) en alliant excellence technologique et approche Lean. Le Groupe fédère aujourd’hui 750 Theodoers répartis dans 3 bureaux (Paris, Londres et Rabat). En forte croissance, il a généré 100 millions d’euros de chiffre d’affaires en 2025. Dans ce contexte, notre dernière enquête interne a clairement fait émerger le besoin d’une communication interne plus lisible, plus régulière et mieux organisée. Pour y répondre, nous avons mené au deuxième semestre 2026 un audit de la communication interne et formulé des orientations pour la professionnaliser : une architecture, des porte-paroles, des standards pour les rituels et les annonces, une cascade d’information, de nouveaux formats et une feuille de route pour 2027. Vous prendrez le relais de ce travail. Votre rôle sera de vous approprier ces recommandations et de les mettre en œuvre avec les dirigeants, les partners et les équipes. Pour fluidifier la communication au sein de l’organisation au bénéfice de la performance Groupe, la direction générale de Theodo crée un poste de Responsable / Directeur de la communication interne . Votre rôle En tant que Responsable de la communication interne, vous êtes le concepteur et le garant du système de communication interne de Theodo : ses règles, ses outils, ses rituels, son calendrier. Vous œuvrez pour que chaque décision stratégique soit communiquée selon les modalités les plus adaptées (par qui, quand, comment). Vous accompagnez de manière transverse l’ensemble des porte-paroles Groupe pour porter les bons messages aux bons publics. Homme / Femme de lien, à l’écoute des signaux faibles et apporteur d’idées pour fluidifier la communication Groupe, vous travaillez au quotidien avec le CEO Office, les fondateurs et les membres du COMEX. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Simulation (Digital Twins)
jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill. You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator. What You'll Work On Map to twin: a pipeline from our lidar maps to simulation-ready digital twins: geometry, semantics, materials, sensors. Training environments: RL environments for learned skills such as multi-robot patrol and search, randomised so nothing overfits one site. Rare events: generate the scenarios real sites rarely produce: intrusions, sabotage, weather, sensor failures. Sensor simulation: RGB, thermal and lidar realistic enough that what is learned in the twin holds on the robot. Sim-to-real: measure the gap on real deployments and close it. The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. jobs.description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. jobs.description: At Graviton, we don t believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? You ll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly. jobs.title: (Senior) Recruiter - Growing Impact Scale Up
jobs.description: Join us in Revolutionizing Supply Chains We’re a fast-growing SaaS scale-up on a mission to shape a sustainable future for the food industry. With four years of continuous 100% year-on-year growth, our team is expanding quickly. We’re looking for a proactive, highly organised Recruiter to help us find the people who will drive that growth, and to help shape how we work as we scale. Join us and shape the future of food sustainability with us! About Simvia Ensuring responsible supply chains is one of the largest challenges of our time. At Simvia we are on a path to enable the food and consumer goods industry to become a force for good, by making it simple to prove that what we eat and use is safe, compliant, and sustainable. Several of Europe's largest retailers, from Albert Heijn to Edeka, have joined Simvia together with their suppliers, and our network now spans more than 200,000 suppliers in 130 countries. AI gives us a strong tailwind: our network holds unique data, and much of the manual work in compliance can now be automated. We are growing rapidly and keep scaling with a driven, international team of 75+ people in the heart of Amsterdam. About this role You will be our first in-house Recruiter. There is no recruitment playbook yet, so you build it: the process, the guardrails and the habits that let us hire fast and well as we scale. That calls for someone who thinks "I'll find a way" rather than "what's the rule here?" Sourcing is the heart of the job. Most of your impact comes from finding and convincing great people who were not looking. Every person you bring in shapes the company we become, so we want someone who lives our culture, not only someone who can describe it. Who thrives here Our culture is driven and kind, and it only works if you bring both. Driven by the mission. You set ambitious goals, own the outcome, and welcome a high bar. Frank. You say what you think and would rather hear the truth than a comfortable story. Open. You ask for feedback

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer COO
jobs.description: At Vio , we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear. As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust. Who we’re looking for We are looking for an experienced Chief Operating Officer (COO) to join our Leadership Team and help us scale our booking operations, drive efficiency and deliver a best-in-class experience for our travelers. Reporting to Oz , Our CEO, and joining Vio's Leadership Team, you'll be hired into the full organisation with a clear first focus: our booking (OTA) business. jobs.description: Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report. Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off. You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow — with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. You'll also get involved in team projects as they come up, working alongside the Financial Reporting team, FP&A and other finance colleagues. jobs.title: Interim Senior Community Manager
jobs.description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another. Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth. We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. We’re on the search for... Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it. In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other. The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp. This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues. The recent trade crisis—sparked by Trump-era tariffs—has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt. That’s where we come in. The Customs Technology team at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing. The opportunity:  Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough. Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. jobs.title: Platform Engineer - Data Resilience and Recovery platform
jobs.description: Build and own a self-service, multi-tenant platform that keeps the critical data of 20+ customers recoverable Do you like building platforms that other teams consume, at scale, across private and public clouds, with security and tenant isolation as non-negotiables? At Schuberg Philis, the world is shifting from traditional backup to data security and resilience. We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to strengthen our Data Management-as-a-Service (DMS) team and help us build the next generation of our platform. About the Team The DMS team builds and runs a shared, fully segregated data resilience platform that serves more than 20 of our customers. Customer teams consume it through self-service, and they handle their own day-to-day backup and restore operations. That means you won’t spend your days on job monitoring, restore tickets or backup schedules. Your customers are internal and external engineering teams, and your product is the platform they build on. You’ll join a dedicated group of data security experts within our larger Services Team and work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. With our plan-build-run approach, you take end-to-end ownership: you design it, you build it, you run it. The Challenge Running one platform for 20+ customers means solving the hard problems of platform engineering: Multi-tenancy by design: strict isolation of data, access, and performance between customers, on shared infrastructure. Self-service at scale: APIs, guardrails and automation that let customer teams onboard and operate independently, without tickets. Scale and resilience: 4,000+ protected endpoints and more than 25,000 recovery points generated daily, on a dedicated private cloud spanning multiple availability zones. Heterogeneous workloads: Oracle, MS-SQL, SAP, Sybase, PaaS, container platforms and VMs across VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure and Kubernetes. Bei PST verantwortest du deinen eigenen Mandanten – inklusive Team, Kundenkommunikation, Prozesssteuerung und Ergebnis. Du triffst Entscheidungen selbst und arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Wir sind ein After-Sales-Dienstleister mit rund 90 Mitarbeitenden in Heiligenhaus. Für führende Elektronikhersteller wie Epson, Tineco und Dreame übernehmen wir Reparatur, Refurbishment und Retouren-Management. Unsere Kunden sind internationale Marken — die Kommunikation mit ihnen findet auf Englisch statt. Wir bauen gerade klare Strukturen auf: definierte Rollen, transparente Gehaltsbänder, echte Verantwortung. Kein Konzern-Overhead, keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Dafür kurze Wege, direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, wirklich etwas zu bewegen. Deine Mission: Du übernimmst einen Mandanten — einen internationalen Hersteller, der uns seine Geräte zur Reparatur anvertraut. Du führst dein Team, du steuerst den Prozess, du hältst die Durchlaufzeiten, du sprichst mit dem Kunden. Wenn etwas nicht läuft, wartest du nicht auf Anweisung — du löst es. Les pièces de caisse en blanc sont en grande majorité réalisées à partir de tôles d’acier mises en forme, dont la conception repose encore largement sur l’expertise et sur des itérations successives entre calcul et dessin. L’optimisation topologique permet de déterminer la meilleure répartition de matière dans un domaine de conception donné. Appliquée à un domaine volumique 3D, elle conduit cependant à des structures massives ou de type treillis, difficilement transposables en pièces embouties d’épaisseur quasi constante. Le défi scientifique consiste à formuler une méthode capable de faire émerger, à partir d’un domaine volumique, des géométries représentatives de tôles (structures à parois minces), en maîtrisant l’épaisseur et la fabricabilité, sous chargements statiques puis dynamiques. Ce stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration de recherche entre le LTDS et ArcelorMittal Global R&D. Il a vocation à se poursuivre par une thèse CIFRE en cas de résultats concluants. L’objectif du stage sera de développer et d’évaluer une première méthodologie d’optimisation topologique 3D aboutissant à une solution en tôle d’acier, en s’appuyant sur une structure automobile. Les missions pourront comprendre : •Un état de l’art des méthodes d’optimisation topologique conduisant à des structures minces de type coque (contrôle d’épaisseur par filtrage et projection, contraintes de longueur caractéristique, approches par composants explicites ou level-set). •Le développement d’un algorithme d’optimisation 3D appliqué à une pièce automobile soumise à des chargements statiques. •L’extension de la méthode à des solutions plus avancées proposées par ArcelorMittal. Les missions pourront être adaptées en fonction

L’équipe intervient auprès des clients Pennylane sur la dimension fonctionnelle de projets en cours : analyse des besoins, cadrage, mise en œuvre, formation et adoption du produit. jobs.title: Stage 2027 - IA/ML Engineer 50% R&D 50% Produit - Statistiques Bayésiennes
jobs.description: Ekimetrics est un leader mondial de l'efficacité marketing et commerciale et des solutions d'IA à l'échelle. Depuis 2006, nous aidons les entreprises à optimiser leur marketing et leurs opérations en combinant IA avec expertise business et technologique dans 4 domaines : Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability. Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous concevons des solutions sur mesure qui transforment les données en impact positif concret, grâce à une combinaison unique de technologie et de services. Notre force est de déployer une IA à impact, à grande échelle. Notre mission : mobiliser cette puissance pour répondre aux défis les plus urgents de notre temps. Nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un impact constant à grande échelle, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN. Contexte Les modèles marketing sont mis à jour à mesure que de nouvelles données arrivent : ventes hebdomadaires, résultats de campagnes, comportement des clients. Ils comprennent les marketing mix models (MMM), qui estiment le retour sur investissement de chaque canal média, ainsi que les modèles de demande et de promotion et les modèles de réponse client. Chaque mise à jour fait bouger les estimations, et la première question des métiers est : pourquoi ont-elles bougé ? Notre équipe a développé une méthode qui y répond de façon exacte pour les modèles bayésiens. Elle répartit le déplacement de toute quantité a posteriori entre des groupes d'observations : semaines, campagnes, régions, segments de clients ou expériences. La méthode est en cours d'évaluation par les pairs. Un premier prototype sur le MMM suit déjà une estimation semaine après semaine et lève une alerte quand une mise à jour la déplace plus que prévu. Sujet : pourquoi l'estimation a-t-elle bougé ? Attribution bayésienne en ligne pour les modèles marketing. Volet

jobs.description: About Scality Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies. Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F Follow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog. Context & Motivation A distributed storage cluster continuously emits telemetry at every level, from the platform and S3 service down to each server and disk. A failing disk, server or storage node leaves traces in these multivariate time series, from subtle shifts in a few metrics to system-wide disruption. Detecting and diagnosing these anomalies early is critical for: Predictive maintenance: isolating or replacing a component before it impacts service Faster diagnosis: pointing support engineers to the root cause, not just to an alert Higher availability and durability of customer data This internship is part of a joint research project between Scality and an INRIA research team. The project released SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection), an open benchmark published at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). It contains 215 real 171-dimensional time series from Scality RING clusters, annotated for injected disk, server and storage-node failures. SHAD's baselines show the problem is far from solved. jobs.title: Head of Operations
jobs.description: At Zoomo, our vision is to transition every commercial urban mile to light electric vehicles (LEVs) to build sustainable and more equitable cities. To that end, we are building the world’s most convenient, affordable, and safe e-bike platform. In 4 years Zoomo has helped transition millions of urban miles to light electric vehicles, built a team of >200 world class engineers, operators, sales staff and vehicle repair technicians; developed and deployed the world's best last mile delivery electric bikes and fleet management software; and successfully deploys these solutions around the world. We operate across the USA, UK, Europe, Canada and Australia. Zoomo vehicles are used by major players in the food, grocery and parcel delivery segments with partners including UberEats, Doordash, JustEat Takeaway, Deliveroo, Domino’s, Pizza Hut, Amazon, FedEx, Getir, Ocado, GoPuff and many more. The Role We’re hiring the most senior leader in France, reporting to the COO, to own market performance end-to-end: operational excellence, growth, and P&L outcomes. You’ll shape and improve our physical operations (fleet, workshop, retail), lead a hands-on team on the ground, and drive pragmatic growth initiatives (pricing, channels, partnerships) to build demand. This role requires an entrepreneurial operator with strong ownership, comfortable both running day-to-day operations and identifying opportunities to improve and grow the business. You can expect to: Drive local growth strategy: identify demand constraints and run pragmatic tests (pricing, offers, channels, local partnerships) with clear measurement. Stabilise and scale core operations (workshop + retail + fleet logistics). Expand capacity thoughtfully as demand grows, ensuring process discipline and cost control. Deliver excellent B2B operations (SLA, onboarding, servicing, reporting) while maintaining focus on B2C growth (majority of the business). Own P&L rhythm for France: budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and trade-off
